notes: The two 'even unto' pairs are taken as the עַד's own rendering; the alternative of marking each 'even' added is named here under rule 8, consistently with 21.24 and 21.26.
t021 'reacheth' is an ASV supply with no source verb to license it: the עַד has already been spent on 'unto', so nothing is left for a lexical verb to complete (rules 20, 49).
